subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 5 7 9 4 2 1 4 7 9 3 2 6 8 5 4 1 9 5 4 3 2 (Right)

How many such even digits are there each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit?4105
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 5 7 9 4 2 1 4 7 9 3 2 6 8 5 4 1 9 5 4 3 2 (Right)

Now,

Even digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81618cb54f76547e12f2df3066b427d410214847fd1bc2ed3132408f4e2c333b.png] 

 

Thus, there is 1 even digit, which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
